title: Vibrant Crispy Kenyan Matcha Skewers
description: A crispy and grassy Kenyan dish featuring matcha, this recipe is keto-friendly and cooked to perfection in a bamboo steamer, whisking up nostalgic feelings with each bite. The combination of matcha and crispy exterior is a unique twist on traditional Kenyan cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the bamboo steamer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the matcha powder, almond flour, salt, and pepper.
Add the coconut oil and eggs to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 20 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a slice of pork sausage in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the sausage and press the edges together to seal the skewer.
Thread the skewers onto the bamboo sticks, leaving a small space between each skewer.
Place the skewers in the bamboo steamer and cook for 12 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the steamer and sprinkle with chopped green onions.
Serve the skewers hot and enjoy.
